package studentcontext

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

// BuildInput identifies one active task action. The authenticated student ID
// remains authoritative; Student verifies action ownership.
type BuildInput struct {
	StudentID        string
	LearningActionID string
	ContextType      domain.LearningContextType
	ContextID        string
}

// Build creates one bounded, in-memory StudentContext for task-scoped policy.
type Build struct {
	Actions            repository.StudentLearningActionContextReader
	Code               repository.StudentLearningActionCodeContextReader
	Mastery            repository.StudentTargetMasteryReader
	Overview           repository.StudentLearnerOverviewReader
	Practice           repository.PracticeTaskContextReader
	PracticeValidation repository.PracticeTeacherValidationContextReader
}

func (useCase Build) Execute(ctx context.Context, input BuildInput) (domain.StudentContext, error) {
	studentID := strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	learningActionID := strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningActionID)
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(studentID); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	if input.ContextType == domain.LearningContextGeneral || input.ContextType == domain.LearningContextLesson {
		if useCase.Overview == nil || learningActionID != "" {
			return domain.StudentContext{}, errors.New("learner overview dependency is required")
		}
		overview, err := useCase.Overview.GetLearnerOverview(ctx, studentID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.StudentContext{}, err
		}
		contextValue, err := domain.NewGeneralStudentContext(overview)
		if input.ContextType == domain.LearningContextLesson {
			contextValue, err = domain.NewLessonStudentContext(overview, input.ContextID)
		}
		if err != nil || contextValue.StudentID != studentID {
			return domain.StudentContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		return contextValue, nil
	}
	if input.ContextType == domain.LearningContextPracticeTask || input.ContextType == domain.LearningContextProject {
		if useCase.Practice == nil || useCase.Mastery == nil {
			return domain.StudentContext{}, errors.New("practice context dependencies are required")
		}
		if _, err := uuid.Parse(learningActionID); err != nil {
			return domain.StudentContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		practice, err := useCase.Practice.GetPracticeTaskContext(ctx, studentID, input.ContextID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.StudentContext{}, err
		}
		var mastery []domain.StudentTargetMastery
		if len(practice.LearningTargets) > 0 {
			mastery, err = useCase.Mastery.GetTargetMastery(ctx, studentID, practice.LearningTargets)
			if err != nil {
				return domain.StudentContext{}, err
			}
		}
		result, err := domain.NewPracticeStudentContext(practice, learningActionID, input.ContextType, mastery)
		if err != nil || input.ContextType != domain.LearningContextPracticeTask || useCase.PracticeValidation == nil {
			return result, err
		}
		validation, validationErr := useCase.PracticeValidation.GetPracticeTeacherValidationContext(ctx, practice, learningActionID)
		if validationErr != nil {
			if errors.Is(validationErr, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable) || errors.Is(validationErr, domain.ErrStudentContextNotFound) {
				return result, nil
			}
			return domain.StudentContext{}, validationErr
		}
		if validation.Available {
			result.PracticeValidation = &validation
		}
		return result, nil
	}
	if useCase.Actions == nil || useCase.Mastery == nil {
		return domain.StudentContext{}, errors.New("student context dependencies are required")
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(learningActionID); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	snapshot, err := useCase.Actions.GetLearningActionContext(ctx, studentID, learningActionID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentContext{}, err
	}
	snapshot, err = domain.NormalizeStudentLearningActionSnapshot(snapshot)
	if err != nil || snapshot.StudentID != studentID || snapshot.LearningActionID != learningActionID {
		return domain.StudentContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	if snapshot.Status != domain.LearningActionStatusOpen {
		return domain.StudentContext{}, domain.ErrLearningActionClosed
	}
	var mastery []domain.StudentTargetMastery
	if len(snapshot.LearningTargets) > 0 {
		mastery, err = useCase.Mastery.GetTargetMastery(ctx, studentID, snapshot.LearningTargets)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.StudentContext{}, err
		}
	}
	result, err := domain.NewStudentContext(snapshot, mastery)
	if err != nil || useCase.Code == nil {
		return result, err
	}
	codeContext, err := useCase.Code.GetLearningActionCodeContext(ctx, studentID, learningActionID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentContext{}, err
	}
	return domain.WithStudentCodeContext(result, codeContext)
}
